social_circle.name: Kayla Martin

demographics.education: high school diploma with some community college coursework

background.how_they_met: Kayla and Trisha became friends locally through mutual friends and fitness activities, then decided to rent together because both wanted independence without paying rent alone.
background.why_close: They share daily household life, Zumba, weekend drives, social plans, and practical support. Kayla is one of the first people Trisha contacts when stressed.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts often and casually, with short practical messages, reaction GIFs, Snapchat-style updates, and teasing reminders when Trisha forgets something.

recent_text_topics: Splitting rent, utilities, groceries, and who needs to send payment before bills are due.
Tuesday Zumba plans, whether Trisha is overbooked, and jokes about needing her phone calendar.
Weekend karaoke or road-trip ideas, including whether they can afford gas and food out.
Trisha's stress about certification, money, and getting more structured.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 names Kayla as Trisha's closest friend: 'My closest friend is Kayla; we do Zumba together and she is usually my passenger for weekend drives.' Q11 says Trisha rents a two-bedroom place with Kayla. Q49 says Trisha would contact 'Kayla or my mom' first for emotional support.

social_circle.name: Denise Wheeler

demographics.education: high school diploma plus some community college classes

background.how_they_met: Denise is Trisha's mother and raised her in Hardin with Trisha's father and younger brother Cody.

recent_text_topics: Trisha's rough clinic week, the chart-note mistake, and reassurance that one mistake does not mean she is not cut out for advancement.
Sunday lunch plans and who else in the family will be there.
Helping with church events, errands, and occasional rides for Trisha's grandma.
Radiography certification planning and whether Trisha is managing money carefully enough.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Trisha's mom is 'the person I call when I am stressed or when I need someone to tell me if I am being dramatic.' Q44 says Trisha called her mom after crying in the car during a rough clinic week. Q103 describes her mother as an office assistant and bookkeeper.

Asking each other for rides, errands, or quick favors around town.
Family lunch timing and whether their parents need help with anything.
Cody's job direction and Trisha nudging him about figuring out his next step.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Trisha has a younger brother, Cody, age 20, and that they are close in a teasing sibling way. Q06 says they talk 'several times a week, usually texting memes or asking each other favors.' Q99 confirms Cody lived with Trisha when she was 16.
